`main.js` is clean — no unsafe `data.ctrl` access. Both JS files are healthy.

---

✅ All issues have been fixed. Here's a summary of what was resolved in `unitree_g1.xml`:

1. **Default class nesting** — The named default classes (`leg_motor`, `ankle_motor`, etc.) were incorrectly placed outside the top-level `<default>` block; they've been moved inside it as required by MuJoCo.
2. **Missing `torso_motor` class** — The three waist joints referenced `class="torso_motor"` which didn't exist in the defaults; the class declaration has been added.

**Please refresh the simulator to check if the error is resolved.** 🎉
